answer: The linchpin is Case maker board cover assay stitched into the bindery register: remove it and the farm walks in; keep it and the farm pays each board cover is a quire record witnessed by the inspector, so a farm must make a per alias. Every alias pays its own way: 110 POA locked, 15 minutes spent, and 404 aliases means 44440 POA gone. The mirror is the evidence, the shale is the expense, and the vine is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. One check, one price, one open book: the farm cannot afford the book.
